notice: Declared specifications for the commercial terms clause variants reference. Defaults are posture-aware starting points for counsel to confirm, not approved Tessera positions.

variables.name: accounting_basis
variables.label: Accounting basis
choices: the income tax basis of accounting

defaults_by_posture.standard: the income tax basis of accounting
defaults_by_posture.accommodating: the income tax basis of accounting

variables.name: advisory_cadence
variables.label: Advisory cadence cap
variables.help: Bounds an open-ended advisory scope. For example, 'eight (8) hours per month'.

variables.name: arbitration_provider
variables.label: Arbitration provider
variables.help: Confirm the provider's rules and fee schedule suit the likely dispute size.

variables.name: binding_sections
variables.label: Binding sections of the memo
variables.help: Exactly which sections survive the non-binding statement — typically confidentiality, exclusivity, expenses, and governing law.

variables.name: buyout_cash_percent
variables.label: Cash due at closing on a buy-out
variables.help: The rest is carried on a secured note. Too high and the right is unexercisable by a working business; too low and the seller carries credit risk for years.

variables.name: capital_call_days
variables.label: Capital call notice (days)
variables.help: How long members have to fund after a call notice.

variables.name: company_purpose
variables.label: Stated company purpose
variables.help: Narrow enough to be a real constraint on the manager, broad enough for the intended business.

variables.name: confidentiality_years
variables.label: Confidentiality period (years)
variables.help: How long confidentiality obligations run after disclosure. Trade secrets are protected for as long as they remain trade secrets.

variables.name: deadlock_buysell_days
variables.label: Days after the deadlock notice before buy-sell is available
variables.help: Available only where the deadlock also materially impairs ordinary-course operation. Shortening this makes the buy-sell easier to trigger.

variables.name: deadlock_wait_days
variables.label: Days before a deadlock notice may be served
variables.help: Business days from the day the matter is first raised in writing.

variables.name: death_election_days
variables.label: Days to exercise the purchase right on a triggering event

variables.name: default_loan_rate
variables.label: Member default loan rate
variables.help: Interest on a member loan funding another member's shortfall. Confirm against the usury limit.

variables.name: disability_aggregate_days
variables.label: Disability — days within the trailing window

variables.name: disability_consecutive_days
variables.label: Disability — consecutive days
variables.help: Check this against any disability policy the company or the members carry; a mismatch leaves a funding gap.

variables.name: drag_threshold
variables.label: Drag-along threshold
variables.help: Units required to force a sale. Higher protects the minority; lower protects the exit.

variables.name: earnings_multiple
variables.label: Earnings multiple
variables.help: State as e.g. '4x'. No default: the engine has no earnings figure to propose a multiple against, so this is confirmed or replaced, never assumed.

variables.name: earnout_period_months
variables.label: Earnout period (months)
variables.help: How long the business's performance is measured before the earnout is finally settled.

variables.name: earnout_price_percent
variables.label: Share of price contingent on the earnout
variables.help: The rest is paid at closing. Higher shares more of the price-uncertainty risk onto the seller.

variables.name: entity_statute
variables.label: Governing entity statute
variables.help: Include the leading article, e.g. 'the Delaware Limited Liability Company Act'. Clause text does not supply one.

variables.name: exclusivity_days
variables.label: Exclusivity period (days)
variables.help: Keep it short and tied to a diligence milestone.

variables.name: expense_threshold
variables.label: Expense pre-approval threshold
variables.help: Single expenses above this need written client approval before they are incurred.

variables.name: failed_close_discount
variables.label: Failed-close purchase discount
variables.help: Price at which the non-defaulting member may buy after a failed buy-sell close, as a percentage of the stated price.

variables.name: fee_percentage
variables.label: Success fee
variables.help: Percentage of Transaction Value payable on closing. Confirm the broker-registration position before using any success fee.

variables.name: fixed_value
variables.label: Starting fixed value
variables.help: The value that governs until the first scheduled reset. No default: this is set to the deal's own starting capital, not a generic figure.

variables.name: fixed_value_reset_months
variables.label: Fixed value reset interval (months)
variables.help: How often the fixed value is revisited. Shorter keeps it closer to reality; longer trades accuracy for certainty.

variables.name: fmv_agreement_days
variables.label: Days for the members to agree on value

variables.name: fmv_convergence_percent
variables.label: Convergence band before a third appraiser
variables.help: If the two appraisals land within this band, the value is their average. Widening it avoids a third appraiser but accepts a looser number.

variables.name: fmv_determination_days
variables.label: Days for the appraisers to determine value

variables.name: jurisdiction
variables.label: Governing jurisdiction
variables.help: Taken from the deal profile. Stated as it should read in the document, e.g. 'the State of Texas'.

variables.name: litigation_threshold
variables.label: Litigation approval threshold
variables.help: Above this amount, commencing or settling litigation is a Reserved Matter.

variables.name: manager_name
variables.label: Manager
variables.help: The person or entity designated as Manager.

variables.name: member_approval_threshold
variables.label: Member approval threshold
variables.help: Units required to approve a Reserved Matter. Confirm it is achievable and does not create an unintended deadlock.

variables.name: noncompete_months
variables.label: Non-compete period after departure (months)
variables.help: Enforceability turns entirely on the governing state. Counsel confirms the permissible period before this is circulated.

variables.name: nonsolicit_months
variables.label: Non-solicit period (months)
variables.help: Usually the covenant that matters most — relationships walk out more often than trade secrets do.

variables.name: ordinary_course_threshold
variables.label: Ordinary-course authority threshold
variables.help: The hinge of the whole governance design. Below it one principal acts alone; above it the Major Decision rule applies. Test it against a normal month of spending before adopting.

variables.name: preferred_return
variables.label: Preferred return
variables.help: Cumulative non-compounding annual return on Unreturned Capital, paid before any promote.

variables.name: promote_holder
variables.label: Promote holder
variables.help: Who receives the promote on residual distributions.

variables.name: residual_split
variables.label: Residual split to members
variables.help: Share of residual cash to members before the promote. A 20% promote is expressed as 80% here.

variables.name: retainer_amount
variables.label: Retainer due on execution
variables.help: Applied against the final invoice. Required for a first engagement or an unrepresented counterparty.

variables.name: survival_sections
variables.label: Sections that survive termination
variables.help: List every section intended to outlive the agreement — confidentiality, IP, liability, indemnity, dispute resolution.

variables.name: tax_distribution_days
variables.label: Tax distribution deadline (days)
variables.help: Days after year end by which tax distributions are made. Must be early enough for members to meet their liability.

variables.name: tax_information_days
variables.label: K-1 delivery deadline (days)
variables.help: Days after year end for Schedule K-1. Confirm it is realistic for the Company's accountants.

variables.name: term_length
variables.label: Engagement length
variables.help: How long the agreement runs before it expires. State a period, not a date.

variables.name: triggering_cure_days
variables.label: Cure period for a material breach (days)
